title: System identification and mechanical resonance frequency suppression for servo control used in single gimbal control moment gyroscope
author: Yue Yu; Lu Dai; Maosheng Chen; Lingbo Kong; Chaoqun Wang; Gengyao Li; Zhipeng Xue
locator: Sections 2–5: two-mass gimbal servo model, resonance identification, experimental frequency-response comparison
license_or_permission: Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0); repository stores metadata and link only
notes: Peer-reviewed study of a single-gimbal control-moment-gyroscope servo, modelled as a two-mass system and validated against an experimental frequency response. Flexible-servo modelling example outside the CNC machine domain; supports model-form reasoning only and must not be used as CNC axis parameter or acceptance evidence.
